intent: Harden a candidate, shadow-only Mission Control graph bridge without production wiring. Bind graph, run, grant, and plan digests; reject foreign state; serialize run/resume; CAS checkpoint parents; and validate bounded observations. A pre-adapter plan reread narrows but does not eliminate the post-check/pre-effect race. Atomic TaskBoard owner CAS or an immutable authorized snapshot spanning effect admission is an explicit production-promotion prerequisite. Receipts and checkpoints never mint authority.

negative_controls.name: mutated-plan-after-admission-must-fail
negative_controls.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; import ast; p=Path('dharma_swarm/graph/mission_control_bridge.py'); s=p.read_text(); needle='    if current != request.plan_digest:\\n'; assert s.count(needle)==1; p.write_text(s.replace(needle,'    if False:\\n')); tree=ast.parse(p.read_text()); fn=next(n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name=='_require_current_plan'); assert any(isinstance(n,ast.Compare) and any(isinstance(op,ast.NotEq) for op in n.ops) for n in ast.walk(fn))"

commit.message: feat(graph): harden shadow mission dispatch bridge

interface_mismatches: Graph persistence lacks a nonblocking per-thread run lease and checkpoint-parent CAS for this bridge.
Task content can mutate after admission, so task identity alone cannot bind the reviewed plan.
Persisted grants and observations are untrusted recovery inputs and cannot confer authority.
honest_blockers: Candidate and shadow-only: no production root imports or invokes this bridge.
Production promotion requires atomic TaskBoard owner CAS or an immutable authorized snapshot spanning effect admission, plus durable idempotent owner effects.
The pre-adapter plan reread narrows but cannot eliminate the post-check/pre-effect race.
File leases and checkpoint CAS are not distributed consensus or production-liveness proof.
Receipts, checkpoints, packet admission, and tests record evidence only; none grants runtime authority.
Hosted CI, review, merge approval, deployment, and live validation remain outside this packet.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the candidate bridge commit. With no production wiring, rollback removes the shadow surface without production-state migration.
